messages: anna (Design): quick sync 11 need to lock down a few things on the Settings form: how we show required fields, validation feedback for multi-step flows, and the delete-team modal copy. aim to finish before handoff to eng. raj (PM): list the options and tradeoffs pls. tess (DevEx): also note: screen-reader behavior for required + live regions. mike (Eng): from implementation side we can support multiple patterns, but prefer low variance. maybe 1 visual pattern + SR helpers. anna (Design): proposals: Option 1 = visible asterisk + a small "Required" legend at the top for long forms. Option 2 = no legend, use visible asterisk on label and sr-only text "required" for compact lists. anna (Design): example markup I19m suggesting: required and set aria-required on the input. raj (PM): for the wizard/multi-step flows we should show an error summary at the top of each step with anchor links to invalid fields. users miss inline errors when theyre scrolled down. tess (DevEx): agree. summary should be focusable, update via aria-live, and keyboard users should land on the first invalid field when they press the summary link. mike (Eng): okay we can emit data-error-anchor attributes and a single handler will do the focus + scrolling. try to avoid re-rendering the whole form on every validation tick. anna (Design): delete-team copy: current label "Delete team" feels under-informative. options: "Permanently delete team" vs "Remove team and all data". Which is clearest? raj (PM): "Permanently delete team" + typed confirmation for org-level teams. for small teams, confirm modal + undo toast is fine. tess (DevEx): typed confirm needs good a11y: explicit instructions, labelled input, and clear error announcements. anna (Design): proposed modal copy: - Title: "Permanently delete team" - Body: "This will permanently delete the team and all associated data. This action cannot be undone. To confirm, type the team name:" - Input label: "Type team name to confirm" - Buttons: Primary: "Delete team" (danger), Secondary: "Cancel" raj (PM): check product: do we actually soft-delete? if yes, say "You can restore within X days". if not, leave it out. mike (Eng): backend currently supports a 14-day soft-delete window for teams. update copy to match. anna (Design): a11y checklist for modal: focus trap, aria-describedby linking to body, primary button disabled (aria-disabled) until typed match, and announce mismatches via role=alert. tess (DevEx): I'll add these to the dev ticket acceptance criteria and include keyboard walkthrough steps. ux-bot: branch "feature/team-delete-ux" pushed for review :rocket: anna (Design): summary: adopt asterisk + sr-only required for compact UI, legend for long forms, step-level error summaries with anchors for multi-step, and "Permanently delete team" modal with typed confirm for org-level deletes + undo toast for light deletes. i'll update Figma and the spec. raj (PM): I'll sync with legal on retention messaging and update the product doc. mike (Eng): noted perf guardrails on validation. tess (DevEx): will QA accessibility and keyboard flows. anna (Design): thanks all :heart: will ping when spec is in the handoff ticket.
